question: Does the separately trained fragment-chain world function remain exact under recursive open-loop rollout in never-trained combined worlds?
controls: condition-deleted and full-context models receive identical training transitions
model predictions are recursively fed back without teacher forcing
learned rollout source may not call the true transition function
two separate-family 64-step retention tests must remain exact
the first complete holdout must repeat bit-for-bit
all model write counters must remain unchanged during evaluation

classifier_dev.role: development route classification only; absent from training, evaluation, and runtime

failure_policy: Retain every drift or unknown rollout; do not replace seeds, alter code, or lower gates after holdout execution.
boundary: Developer-frozen synthetic open-loop prediction. Actions, raw channels, local window, global state container, task generators, and evaluator are supplied.
